description: This file defines an HTTP client class for making requests to the LiteLLM proxy server, including methods for initializing the client and sending HTTP requests with customizable parameters.

classes.name: HTTPClient
classes.description: A class providing methods to perform HTTP requests to the LiteLLM proxy server, supporting configuration of base URL, API key, and timeout.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the HTTPClient with base URL, optional API key, and timeout.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with specified method, URI, headers, data, and JSON payload, returning the parsed JSON response.
